message.content:
VERDICT: do-now
WHY: v24.18.1 is explicitly a security release fixing twelve CVEs, including three rated High (http2 header memory accounting, http2 rst stream handling, and a permission model radix split issue) plus several Medium-severity http2/https/zlib/dns fixes. The two subsequent releases are ordinary semver-minor feature drops with no breaking changes or migrations called out.
WHAT_IT_WILL_TAKE: Nothing beyond the normal update process - it's a drop-in patch/minor bump within the same major line, so just recreate the container or swap the binary and restart dependent services.
message.reasoning: v24.18.1 is a security release with multiple CVEs, several High severity. That's do-now. No breaking changes noted; minor releases are semver-minor features. Update is within same major line, drop-in replacement.
